moments.title: Starlink 4-31 over Los Angeles
moments.notes: A Falcon 9 from Vandenberg at 6:14 pm PDT with the Sun just below the horizon: its exhaust is lit. The launch is published; the sight is computed.

moments.title: The first Starlink train, Leiden
moments.notes: Sixty satellites a day after launch. Marco Langbroek filmed the train near 22:55 UT on 24 May 2019 from Leiden; the reconstruction has it rising at 22:55.

moments.title: Falcon Heavy's first flight, Titusville
moments.notes: Lift-off at 3:45 pm EST from Kennedy; the ascent in daylight, seen from across the river. The ascent is a Falcon profile; the two side boosters are not drawn.

moments.title: Artemis I leaves in the night, Titusville
moments.notes: Lift-off at 1:47 am EST on 16 November 2022. The ascent is a typical profile for a rocket of its size, not the SLS's own.

moments.title: Total eclipse, Madras, Oregon, 2017
moments.notes: Totality in the middle of the path, at 10:20 am PDT.

moments.title: Total eclipse, Kerrville, Texas, 2024
moments.notes: Totality at 1:34 pm CDT, the Sun high in the south.

moments.title: Total eclipse, Luxor, 2027
moments.notes: The longest eclipse of the century, near its greatest, the Sun almost overhead. A future moment: the maths is the same.

moments.title: The Great Conjunction, Houston, 2020
moments.notes: Jupiter and Saturn a tenth of a degree apart in the dusk, on the night of the solstice.

moments.title: The moonless night of the Titanic, 1912
moments.notes: Twenty to midnight by ship's time, 14 April 1912, at the collision: a clear, calm night with no Moon (a waning crescent, long set), facing the bow's way, west.

moments.title: Moonrise, Hernandez, New Mexico, 1941
moments.notes: Ansel Adams's photograph, 4:49:20 pm MST on 1 November 1941, as astronomers dated it from the Moon's place: a waxing gibbous Moon due east, a few degrees up.

moments.title: Venus before dawn, Saint-Rémy, 1889
moments.notes: Van Gogh painted The Starry Night in June 1889: the bright star over the hills is Venus, the morning star, rising in the east before dawn.

moments.title: Summer solstice sunrise, Stonehenge
moments.notes: The Sun rises over the Heel Stone, about 50 degrees from north.

moments.title: Sunrise at Abu Simbel, 22 February
moments.notes: Twice a year the first light runs down the temple to the statues in its heart: 22 February and 22 October.

moments.title: Manhattanhenge, New York
moments.notes: The setting Sun on the line of the street grid, 29 degrees north of west.
